description: One HTTPS probe of a public domain: status, latency and whether it looks up. Returns { domain, up, status, ms }: up is true for any status below 500; status is null when the host does not answer. Price: 2 credits (1 credit = 1 CAD cent) per successful call; input that does not match the schema is rejected before billing.

domain.description: Public domain name, e.g. example.com; IP literals and private suffixes (.local, .internal, .lan, .corp) are refused.

path.description: Path to probe, starting with /, letters, digits, _ . / - only.

name: uptime-check
title: Uptime check
